recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下可見許多大型組織球，細胞質豐富淡粉紅、核圓而空泡狀並有小核仁，胞質內包著完整的淋巴球與漿細胞（emperipolesis），周圍大量漿細胞，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm and ill-defined borders
Round vesicular histiocyte nuclei with small distinct nucleoli
Intact small lymphocytes and plasma cells within histiocyte cytoplasm, often surrounded by a clear halo (emperipolesis)
Dense background of mature plasma cells with eccentric clock-face nuclei and small lymphocytes
Scattered clear spaces/cleft artifact; no significant nuclear atypia or mitotic activity
describe_en: High-power H&E section of lymph node shows sheets and clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli. Many histiocytes contain intact lymphocytes and plasma cells within their cytoplasm, frequently within clear halos, indicating emperipolesis. The background is rich in mature plasma cells and small lymphocytes, without atypical large cells or Reed-Sternberg-like forms. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease; S100 positivity with CD1a negativity in the histiocytes supports the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Langerhans cells are smaller with grooved coffee-bean nuclei, accompanied by eosinophils, lack emperipolesis and are CD1a/langerin positive.
Histiocytes are smaller, lack prominent emperipolesis and are S100 negative.
Histiocytes phagocytose red cells, nuclear debris and platelets that are degraded, rather than harboring intact viable lymphocytes, and S100 is negative.
Shows plasma cell-rich infiltrate but lacks large S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis and has increased IgG4+ plasma cells.
